Decorte Sun Shelter Multi Protection Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ feels luxurious from the first touch. The texture is silky, lightweight, and pleasantly glide-on. It absorbs quickly without leaving a chalky or white cast on most skin tones. The finish leans natural-dewy, which makes the skin look polished with or without makeup. It layers well under primers and foundations without pilling or balling. The sunscreen offers strong protection against UVA and UVB rays with SPF 50+ and PA++++. In daily use, it holds up to incidental sun exposure during a typical workday. For longer outdoor activities, reapplication is recommended as with any sunscreen. The product has a skincare-forward feel, delivering hydration that helps prevent dry patches. A faint, pleasant fragrance is present but dissipates quickly, which some may enjoy while others may prefer fragrance-free options. The scent is noticeable upon application but non-irritating for most users. Packaging feels premium, with a controlled dispensing mechanism that minimizes waste. The product is reasonably portable, though its luxurious branding can make it feel less travel-discreet. It sits comfortably on the skin and does not cause tightness or irritation for most skin types. Those with oily skin may appreciate a light powder touch-up later in the day. It plays nicely with most layers, including serums and moisturizers, for a seamless skincare routine. If you're fragrance-sensitive, patch testing is wise before full use. T

avis.titre: Elegant, Lightweight, and No White Cast

It layers well under makeup and doesnt leave a white cast, even on medium skin tones. I appreciate how it protects against pollution and dryness too, not just UV.

Ive used this sunscreen for two days, and its already a favorite. It feels light, absorbs quickly, and layers perfectly with my other skincare products. No pilling or white cast, just smooth, hydrated, glowy skin. I love how comfortable it feels, a great protection without any heaviness.

avis.titre: Feels more like skincare than sunscreen!
avis.texte: What I love most about this product is that I have found I can skip my moisturizer because this sunscreen is plenty hydrating on its own. Its very comfortable to wear and leaves your skin feeling silky smooth. It truly feels more like a skincare product than a sunscreen!i received this product complimentary from Decorte in exchange for my honest opinion.

This is a great sunscreen for my dry skin. It doesnt leave a white cast and also doesnt pill. It applies well under makeup also so thats a plus. My skin feels protected all day. Complimentary from Decorte

Decorte Sun Shelter Multi Protection Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ is lovely! I am 38, I have naturally tan colored skin, I have acne prone skin, and I wear makeup almost every day. This sunscreen sits well on my face after all my normal skincare and then layering makeup on top of that. It doesnt leave a white cast, just a beautiful, hydrated, glowing complexation. I not only feel protected from the sun, but this works as a primer and moisturizer for my makeup as well. It is a thick cream that spreads out easily and absorbs very well. It has a very light and pleasant scent that makes me feel fancy when I use it! I love that my skin looks radiant all day long when I am wearing this sunscreen. I definitely recommend this unique multi-purpose sunscreen, just remember to apply it as the last thing in your skincare routine. I received this product complimentary from Decorte in exchange for my honest opinion.

This sunscreen has a lightweight, milky texture that spreads easily over the skin. It absorbs well without leaving a white cast or greasy residue. It layers nicely under makeup, making it a great option for daily use. Overall, Im very pleased with its performance. Gifted by Decorte.

I am an instant fan of any Japanese sunscreen and this one takes the cake, it provides smooth and good coverage on my skin as my last step in my morning skin routine before I put on makeup. I havent gotten burned with this.

I love multitasking products so I was very excited to try this sunscreen and it did not disappoint. Not only does it feel luxurious, offer great sun protection at SPF 50, but it moisturizers the skin and boosts radiance as well. I feel like I can get away with not using a standalone moisturizer with this sunscreen in the summer and in the colder months it would offer that extra hydration boost my skin needs. It goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly without white cast, such a great addition to my skincare routine. Gifted by decortebeauty.

I love the sunscreen so much because I could use it as a primer underneath my make up and you dont see any white cast. It has quickly become my favorite choice when applying a sunscreen in the morning, and Im very consistent with applying sunscreen. Gifted by decortebeauty

Goes on silky smooth, almost like a primer, with zero white cast. My skin feels soft and not greasy at all after applying, and makeup sits really well on top. It doesnt sting around my eyes, which is rare!
